subject: The tasting room on weeknights
body:
Hi,

Brine & Barrel's site says the tasting room seats 18, and the kitchen closes when the bread runs out. Sales are up 40% this year, so the room is going to feel smaller than that number.

A short conversation could look at which seatings are still easy and which ones already stack up.

Worth a 15-minute chat?

Alex Example
